type.description: The type of the Address Group. Possible values are "IPV4" or "IPV6".
type.rationale: This policy only permits the value "IPV4" for the type attribute. The compliant configuration uses "IPV4", while the non-compliant configuration uses "IPV6". Enforcing IPV4 ensures the address group matches the approved security requirement.

location.description: The location of the gateway security policy. The default value is `global`.

labels.description: Set of label tags associated with the AddressGroup resource. An object containing a list of "key": value pairs. Example: { "name": "wrench", "mass": "1.3kg", "count": "3" }. **Note**: This field is non-authoritative, and will only manage the labels present in your configuration. Please refer to the field `effective_labels` for all of the labels present on the resource.

items.description: List of IP addresses or CIDR ranges allowed in the address group.
items.rationale: Only the specific CIDR block 10.10.0.1/30 is permitted to enforce strict network access control and minimize attack surface.

purpose.description: List of supported purposes of the Address Group. Each value may be one of: `DEFAULT`, `CLOUD_ARMOR`.
purpose.rationale: Restricting purpose to CLOUD_ARMOR enforces consistent security usage and prevents misconfiguration of address groups in non-secure or unintended contexts.

parent.description: The name of the parent this address group belongs to. Format: organizations/{organization_id} or projects/{project_id}.
